entries.title: Every season on the Races page, 2019 to 2026 (173 races): the years before INDY NXT folded under their year's dots, or open

values.label: folded (default): each year 2019-2023 shows its dots, one per race coloured by series, and a 'Show the N races' button opens its rows
open: every year's rows listed under its dots, all 173 rows on the page

entries.look: Races. Use the year links under the title to jump; point at (or tap) any dot in any season for the track card; open 2019 and click a race; open a DNF/DNS race (2019 Watkins Glen Race 3) to see its own page.

entries.title: The track on each Races row: the 3D still, as in the Career explorer's cards, or round seven's bird's-eye icon

values.label: 3D still (default): the venue's model at its opening angle, the race's own shaded still where one exists; the 2D line only where no model exists
bird's-eye icon (live now): the model seen from straight above, line drawing where none

entries.look: Races → any INDY NXT season's rows, and 2024's FR Oceania rows (no models yet: the picture column drops out).
